discovery: Actually returned H candidate; explicitly assigned by control for parallel research. Not an assertion of backend selection or qualification.
retrieval_mode: Public pages opened and read through web tool; content may be cached. No direct HTTP receipt, product execution, provider enrichment or independent validation.
suggested_research_priority: A named provider-operations product family warrants focused product inspection; founder identity/contribution and independent use remain unresolved.

source_groups.origin: Company-controlled pages; three pages are one claim-origin group, not three independent confirmations.

claims: Company describes Ledger for billing, Manifest for insurance discovery, and early-access Authority and Roster for prior authorization and credentialing.
Homepage describes practice-configurable review gates and claims design partners live since Q1 2026; named implementation/customer claims are not independently checked.
Portal tour is explicitly labeled as demo data. No application session or video execution was inspected.
limits: A detailed public product description is not hands-on proof or validated customer benefit.
Early-access labeling should not be rewritten as all products fully deployed.
Compliance and audit statements are company assertions, not verified certifications.

claims: Ledger is described as handling claim filing, appeals, reconciliation and underpayment detection, with an ingest/review/submit workflow and named EHR/clearinghouse integrations.
limits: Integration names do not establish working customer deployments.
This retrieved page states human review on every external submission; the homepage describes configurable automation. Resolve version/scope before asserting an absolute approval policy.
Generic industry billing statistics on the page are not measured company outcomes.

claims: Company describes a New Jersey engineering team serving practices; no individual founder names or person-level product contributions appear in the retrieved about-page text.
limits: No named founder in these pages does not establish absence of founders or relevant expertise.
Provider-indexed description has three products; the retrieved homepage has four. Prefer explicit current-page attribution rather than silently merging snapshots.

possible_brief.company_description: Replicate.Health describes AI tools for medical-practice billing, insurance discovery, authorizations and credentialing.
possible_brief.strongest_company_signal: Named workflows and a described product loop provide concrete material for C1/C3/C4 investigation.
possible_brief.founder_signal: No individual founder or attributable contribution established in reviewed sources; retain unknown.
possible_brief.decisive_check: Identify current founders and their contribution, then inspect one actual practice workflow and corroborate use, review burden and benefit.

open_questions: Who are the current founders and who designed/built the reusable core?
Which products are operational beyond early access, and can a practice corroborate actual use?
What is the measured baseline-to-outcome benefit after human review and integration effort?
Current financing stage, ownership, YC backing and pipeline novelty are unknown.
